title: Thank you for creating such a wonderful app!
body:
I’ve been using this app for quite a while, and I truly love it. I even have a paid subscription because I believe it’s one of the best habit and goal tracking apps available. The design is so cute, the features are well thought out and it has helped me stay focused on my goals.
I do have one suggestion that I think could make the app even better. Sometimes, because of my own psychological barriers, I simply don’t have the motivation to open the app and manually log or check off my habits, even when I actually complete them. It’s not an issue with the app itself – it’s just something I personally struggle with.
It would be amazing if you could add some kind of AI assistant or smart companion that could make the process easier. For example, it could ask simple questions or help me quickly log completed habits through a conversation. IDK, I think this would make the app much more accessible for people who struggle with motivation or executive functioning.

title: Great app, but issue with tracking on Apple Watch after watchOS 11.0 update
body:
I’ve been using Habit for a while now and have always been satisfied with its functionality. However, since the latest watchOS 11.0 update, I’ve been experiencing issues when using the app from the watch. While I can still mark tasks as completed, when it comes to tasks where I need to input specific amounts (like ml of water), the app is freezing. I’m unable to adjust the progress or modify details from the watch, it only allows me to check tasks off as done or not done. 

This is quite frustrating as I primarily use the Apple Watch for tracking, and now the app is only fully functional from the phone. I’ve tried reinstalling the app on the watch, but the issue persists. I have the premium version of the app and really hope this can be resolved soon, as it has affected my usual workflow. 

Could you please assist with fixing this problem?

title: Błąd po włączeniu synchronizacji z iCloud
body:
Po zainstalowaniu aplikacji i włączeniu w ustawieniach „synchronizuj z iCloud” aplikacja się wyłącza i nie da się jej ponownie uruchomić. Trzeba ją usunąć (wraz z ustawionymi nawykami i zapisanymi wynikami) i zainstalować na nowo. Bardzo słaby początek, a już szykowałam się na zakup pełnej wersji:( 

Mam zrobione wszystkie aktualizacje, reset telefonu nie pomaga.

body: First thing: I love your App! Probably sth known already, but the app crashes when open ‘Habit tracker’ screen (4th tab on the bottom) and then tap on ‘Yearly’ at the top of the screen. body: The potential is big, but the reality... well I thought I’ll be using it mostly on Watch, then analyzing on iPhone. And the Apple Watch app... it’s not there yet. It should be clear, quick and easy to use on Watch. It’s not. I paid for it and now I regret it ☹️
